from solution import min_Ops
import inspect


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Example assert min_Ops([2,2,2,2],4,3) == 0."""
    assert min_Ops([2, 2, 2, 2], 4, 3) == 0  # already equal: 4-4=0 ops


def test_issue_all_equal_three_elements():
    """Already equal elements need 0 operations to make all elements equal."""
    assert min_Ops([5, 5, 5], 3, 2) == 0  # already equal: 3-3=0 ops


def test_issue_all_equal_single_element():
    """A single element is already equal so 0 operations are required."""
    assert min_Ops([9], 1, 5) == 0  # single element: 1-1=0 ops


def test_issue_all_equal_negative_values():
    """Already equal elements need 0 operations to make all elements equal."""
    assert min_Ops([-4, -4, -4, -4], 4, 2) == 0  # already equal: 4-4=0 ops


def test_issue_all_equal_zeros():
    """Already equal elements need 0 operations to make all elements equal."""
    assert min_Ops([0, 0, 0, 0], 4, 7) == 0  # already equal: 4-4=0 ops


def test_issue_all_equal_ignores_k():
    """Already equal elements need 0 operations regardless of k."""
    assert min_Ops([4, 4, 4], 3, 99) == 0  # already equal: 3-3=0 ops


def test_issue_unequal_two_elements():
    """Operations required to make all elements equal is non-zero when unequal."""
    assert min_Ops([1, 2], 2, 1) != 0  # difference 2-1=1 so cannot be 0


def test_issue_unequal_three_elements():
    """Operations required to make all elements equal is non-zero when unequal."""
    assert min_Ops([1, 2, 3], 3, 1) != 0  # spread 3-1=2 so cannot be 0


def test_contract_signature_three_params():
    """Public interface is min_Ops(arr, n, k) with three parameters."""
    sig = inspect.signature(min_Ops)  # 1+1+1=3 params expected
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 3  # 1+1+1=3


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Number of operations required must be returned as an int."""
    assert isinstance(min_Ops([2, 2, 2, 2], 4, 3), int) is True  # 1==1 is True


def test_contract_returns_nonnegative():
    """Number of operations required cannot be negative."""
    assert min_Ops([2, 2, 2, 2], 4, 3) >= 0  # 0>=0 since 4-4=0
